name: Charlotte Moretti
source:
An opportunity of a lifetime presents itself when Charlotte is given a major role in investigating the infamous Grey City Syndicate.
Little does anyone know what heavy secrets she keeps in her heart. After a long, yet shadowed career as a secret agent, this mission is a personal one, and it may very well be her last.
